name: Butler
ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow, you may only vote if they are voting too.
designRole: Voting restriction tied to a chosen master; changes public voting discipline.
explanation: Voting restriction tied to a chosen master; changes public voting discipline.

jinxes.reason: If the Organ Grinder is causing eyes closed voting, the Butler may raise their hand to vote but their vote is only counted if their master voted too.
If the Cannibal gains the Butler ability, the Cannibal learns this.
